rules.title: Network-Hosted PowerShell With Suspicious Execution Options

detection_logic.summary: Detects Sysmon Event ID 1 PowerShell process creation where the command line contains generic UNC syntax and at least one suspicious PowerShell execution option.
detection_logic.sigma_yaml:
title: Network-Hosted PowerShell With Suspicious Execution Options
id: 9e29a0f4-8d8d-43d2-8f7f-20e07ef2e2b4
status: proposed
description: Detects PowerShell or pwsh process creation from a generic UNC path with suspicious execution options. This is a Component A candidate and does not independently establish destructive impact.
author: Project Janus
date: 2026-08-11
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_event:
    EventID: 1
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\\powershell.exe'
      - '\\pwsh.exe'
  selection_unc:
    CommandLine|contains: '\\\\'
  selection_options:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
      - '-NonInteractive'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
  selection_noprofile_command:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '-NoProfile'
      - '-Command'
  condition: selection_event and selection_image and selection_unc and (selection_options or selection_noprofile_command)
falsepositives:
  - Approved administration scripts executed from network shares
  - Software deployment or logon scripts
  - PowerShell automation using noninteractive or execution-policy options
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Normalized data.event_id is 1, data.process_image ends in powershell.exe, and data.command_line contains UNC syntax and -NoProfile, -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, and -Command.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Normalized baseline process-creation record has data.event_id 1 but data.process_image is hostname.exe and data.command_line has no generic UNC syntax or suspicious PowerShell execution option.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: A matching Sysmon process-creation record is expected when PowerShell executes a network-hosted command with a suspicious execution option.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: No matches are expected for baseline records that lack both a PowerShell process image and generic UNC command-line syntax with suspicious execution options.

limitations: This Sigma candidate detects Component A only and does not independently establish destructive filesystem activity.
Legitimate administration, deployment, logon, backup, or maintenance automation can execute PowerShell from UNC paths with similar options.
Sigma field mappings and correlation support vary by backend.

deployment_target.description: Portable Sigma artifact; not actively deployed in the MVP

rules.title: Network-Hosted PowerShell Correlated With Destructive Script Content

detection_logic.summary: Correlates network-hosted PowerShell process creation with suspicious execution options and PowerShell operational content containing destructive filesystem operations on the same host within 300 seconds.

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Component A provenance: normalized data.event_id is 1, data.process_image is PowerShell, and data.command_line contains generic UNC syntax with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass and -NoProfile.

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Component B provenance: normalized data.event_id is 4103 and data.script_text contains Remove-Item within PowerShell operational content.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Baseline process-creation provenance lacks PowerShell image, generic UNC syntax, and suspicious PowerShell execution options in normalized data fields.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: A high-confidence result is expected when Component A and Component B occur on the same normalized host within 300 seconds; isolated component matches are expected to be medium confidence.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: No correlated matches are expected when baseline records do not contain both the network-hosted suspicious PowerShell execution pattern and destructive PowerShell content.

limitations: PowerShell Event IDs 4103 and 4104 depend on logging configuration and may be absent.
Correlation uses normalized host and a five-minute window; without cross-source process identifiers, unrelated activity on the same host can be joined.
Generic UNC PowerShell execution and destructive filesystem commands can be legitimate administrative or maintenance activity.
A Component A-only or Component B-only result is medium confidence and requires analyst review.

deployment_target.description: Windows machine running the Project Janus Python scripts
deployment_target.destination: Project Janus controller proposed active-rules location
